hooks.command:
INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'make (build|test|coverage)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUseFailure","additionalContext":"BUILD/TEST FAILED. STOP. Before retrying, you MUST answer ALL 4 questions:
(1) What is the EXACT error message?
(2) Which pipeline stage? (parse/desugar/resolve/typecheck/mono/codegen/link/runtime)
(3) What did you change since the last successful build?
(4) Does the SEED match the current source? (If you added enum variants, run: make seed-patch-traps)

DO NOT retry until you answer all 4 in your response. If error is undefined variable after enum changes, the seed is stale."}}'; fi

echo '{"systemMessage":"SESSION START CHECKLIST — READ BEFORE DOING ANYTHING:

1. Run: cd bootstrap && make test — verify spec tests + selfhost fixed point
2. Task tracking is the Agent Tasks MCP (mcp__Agent_Tasks__ready / show / update)
3. NEVER close a ticket without 100% completion (CLAUDE.md rule 19)
4. NEVER defer work. Do it or leave the ticket open.
5. When adding new enum variants to ValueType/Expr/Stmt: run make seed-patch-traps FIRST
6. When make build fails: STOP. Answer 4 questions before retrying.
7. When make build fails with undefined variable after seed changes: the seed is stale. Run make seed-patch-traps && make clean && make build
8. After every successful change: git add + commit + push. Do NOT batch."}'
echo '{"systemMessage":"SESSION END — before stopping: (1) Are all changes committed and pushed? (2) Are any tickets left in-progress that should be updated? (3) Does make test still pass?"}'
